stations.title: Clemency
stations.say: What does one phone order come to?

stations.title: Her sum by hand
stations.text: Every phone order added up and divided.

stations.title: Year-end notes
stations.text: One average per channel, in pounds.

captions: At Mallowfield Seeds, Clemency needs the average order of each channel for her notes.
Her sum by hand gives less than the report, and the market comes out in whole pounds.
You count it by hand, then fix the average and the trade price list.
Now each average is what one order really comes to, to the penny.
Same orders, same pence. Every number answers the question Clemency asked.
